method: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter. Then add urad dal and cumin, and roast them.
Add curry leaves and peeled small onions, and sauté well.
Add green chilies cut in half and garlic cloves, and sauté.
Add the chopped assorted vegetables and stir well.
Pour enough rice-washed water (kazhani thanneer) to just submerge the vegetables.
Extract the juice from the tamarind (soaked in rice-washed water) and pour it into the pan.
Add salt, cover with a lid, and let it cook for 10 minutes.
Once the vegetables are cooked, add the boiled karamani.
Pour half a cup of coconut milk and bring it to a good boil.
Serve as a side dish for Chapathi or Idiyappam.
